about: The rules lint_project enforces on a XIOS/3 package before it goes to a CloudBackend PaaS tenant. The tenant's Deploy Wizard validates strictly where a local XVM is loose, and a webshare answers every path with the boot page, so most of these are traps the reader would otherwise find after deploying. This file is the one source: the tool reads it, and the prose in the workflow skill is written from it. A rule has an id, a title, the profile it belongs to (build rules run in both profiles, ship rules only in ship), its severity (error, warning or info), the message and the fix, both with {placeholders} the tool fills per finding.

profiles.build: What must hold before upload_project: the manifest, the grammar the strict validator rejects, references, secrets, size limits.
profiles.ship: Everything in build, plus what the served files must satisfy on a webshare: ASCII, no colours outside the token theme, render stylesheets that stay fast, the URL prefix rule.

allowed_xpath_functions.status: to be measured on a tenant
allowed_xpath_functions.todo: Robin: run each of these functions in a process step on a tenant deployment and record the date in measured_on. Until then the list is the union of the documented XIOS/3 functions and the XPath 1.0 core library; the tenant's strict validator may accept fewer, so a documented function can still be refused there.
sources: the XIOS/3 functions reference, 53 documented functions
datadoc: seen in the absolute-path reference example, not documented on its own

rules.title: The manifest and the files it links validate against the XIOS/3 schemas
rules.fix: The same schemas the VS Code extension and upload_project validate against; fix the element or attribute named, then lint again.
rules.notes: Every XML file reached from index.xml through xlink:href is validated. A <proxy> child of a channel operation is the one schema complaint the tenant deploys through (Deploy Anyway); it is reported under G17 instead.

rules.title: The manifest is index.xml with an <application> root, version on <about> and never on <process>
rules.fix: Name the manifest index.xml at the package root, give it an <application> root and <about version="...">, and take version off every <process> (the Deploy Wizard refuses it there).

rules.title: No view file named view.xml; view names unique
rules.fix: Name view files after the view (views/mainView.xml). Two <view> declarations may share a name only when each has its own screen= media query.

rules.title: Expressions use only the allowed functions
rules.message: {file} line {line}: {function}() is not an allowed function
rules.fix: Use a documented XIOS/3 function or an XPath 1.0 core function; the allowed list is allowed_xpath_functions in the grammar (its status says whether it has been measured on a tenant).

rules.title: The call operation names its step with value=
rules.message: {file} line {line}: <operation name="call"> uses step= instead of value=
rules.fix: <operation name="call" value="stepId"/>: value names the step; step= is not an attribute of call.

rules.title: No <select>, <option> or <a> in views
rules.message: {file} line {line}: <{tag}> is not a XIOS/3 component
rules.fix: The tenant dialect flattens raw HTML in views. Use <combobox> for a choice and a button, label or render for a link; raw HTML belongs only in a listview's XSL.

rules.title: A process with <script href> has a start step
rules.message: {file} line {line}: the process loads a script but has no <step id="start">
rules.fix: Add <step id="start"><alias name="myProcess" value="started"/></step>: without it a call made before the import finishes is skipped silently.

rules.title: Every link resolves inside the package
rules.fix: Link to a file that is in the package, by a path relative to the linking file that stays inside the package root.

rules.title: Custom component tags are XML names that do not collide with native components
rules.fix: Give the component a tag that is a plain XML name (letters, digits, '-', '_', '.') and is not the name of a built-in component.
rules.notes: A tag that is not an XML name is an error. A tag that shadows a native component name is a warning: validation lets the app's declaration win, but a reader of the view cannot tell the two apart.

rules.title: Served text files are ASCII
rules.fix: The webshare labels an ASCII file ISO-8859-1 and a UTF-8 file UTF-8; other cases were not verified. Use character references in XML and HTML (ö) and \u escapes in JavaScript.

rules.title: Colours live in one token theme, never in views or styles
rules.fix: Declare exactly one <theme tokens="true"> in the manifest with literal values in <tokens> (including the font family) and the seeds in <colors>; read var(--xios-color-*) everywhere else. A hex as a var() fallback is allowed.

rules.title: No fetch or XMLHttpRequest to external hosts in JavaScript
rules.fix: Declare a proxy channel in the process and call the API with callService through it; the key stays in the proxy's configuration, never in the package.

rules.title: No key- or token-shaped strings
rules.fix: Everything in a deployed container is publicly readable. Remove the value, rotate it, and route the call through a proxy channel.

rules.title: A tenant-shared package guards its writes to home://
rules.message: {file} line {line}: a database write to {href} with no guard, in a package shared with the tenant
rules.fix: On a shared deployment home:// is each visitor's own drive. Create the container first inside <operation name="decision" value="home://..."><when exists="false">, or write under tenant://.

rules.title: Render stylesheets iterate with for-each and call-template, and emit no
rules.fix:
xsl:for-each with xsl:call-template renders a list in the runtime's XSLT engine far faster than xsl:apply-templates; a
renders as two line breaks, so use block elements.

rules.title: No font file over 200 KB
rules.fix: The runtime includes the Lucide icons; ship only the glyphs you use as SVG, and a text font as a system stack or a subset.

rules.title: At most 500 text files, 2 MB each, 8 MB in all
rules.fix: upload_project refuses a larger package; keep assets small and binary files out (they cannot be uploaded as text).

rules.title: A proxy channel is expected to be flagged by the Deploy Wizard
rules.message: {file} line {line}: <proxy> under a channel operation: expected, deploy with Deploy Anyway
rules.fix: Nothing to change. The wizard's verifier reports 'proxy is not a valid child of operation' for the documented proxy channel; the deployment goes through with Deploy Anyway.

rules.title: The deployment name and URL prefix are lowercase letters and digits, not beginning with xios
rules.fix: A deployment name is [a-z0-9]+ (it becomes the host name). The host's robots.txt disallows every path beginning with xios, and /xios/ is the host's own runtime, so choose another prefix.

rules.title: Every trigger and every #view#component reference resolves to a named component
rules.fix: Name every component in the view and spell the view and component names in the process exactly as the view does; a trigger that resolves to nothing fires nothing, silently.

rules.title: With a <login>, the login process loads first and the app's own view and process load on request
rules.fix: Put <process xlink:actuate="onLoad" xlink:href="xios://apps/login.xml"/> before the main process, and xlink:actuate="onRequest" on your own <view> and <process> elements.
